answer: Score influence by two-hop expansion: an identity's reward weight counts only attestations that reach at least ten distinct established roots within two hops of the attestation graph. A sybil ring can attest itself forever, but its paths loop back and never expand, so its weight stays near zero. Honest work rides the tide of the wider graph; a fake cluster stays an island guarding an empty vault, visible but unrewarded, and buying real two-hop reach costs more than the reward it unlocks.
